topic_zh: 存储估算：一年要多少硬盘
topic_en: Storage estimation: how much disk per year

xhs.title: 面试问一年要多少硬盘？四个数一乘
xhs.body:
系统设计第 4 课：存储估算
公式：每天新增条数 × 每条大小 × 365 × 副本数
例子（估算）：日活 1000 万，每人每天 2 条 → 2000 万条/天；每条约 1 KB → 每天 20 GB；× 365 ≈ 7.3 TB；存 3 份 ≈ 22 TB/年
单位每级乘 1000（KB→MB→GB→TB→PB），严格是 1024，估算用 1000 就行
要是每条带一张 200 KB 的图，一年就是 1.5 PB：先算大头
考考你：每天新增 100 万条，每条 2 KB，存 3 份，一年大约多少？A 2.2 TB / B 22 TB，评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: How much disk does a system need per year? Records per day × size × 365 × copies. Quick quiz: 1 million new records a day, 2 KB each, 3 copies. About how much per year? A) 2.2 TB or B) 22 TB? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: How much disk does it need per year? Multiply four numbers.
linkedin.body:
Storage estimate = new records per day × size per record × 365 × number of copies.
Example (estimate): 10M daily users × 2 posts = 20M posts/day. At ~1 KB each that's ~20 GB/day, ~7.3 TB/year, ~22 TB with 3 copies.
Use 1000 per unit step (KB → MB → GB → TB → PB); 1024 is exact in binary units, but 1000 is fine for estimates.
Then find the biggest item: one 200 KB image per post is ~1.5 PB/year, and the text barely matters.
Quick quiz: 1 million new records a day, 2 KB each, 3 copies. About how much per year? A) 2.2 TB or B) 22 TB?

quiz.q_zh: 每天新增 100 万条，每条 2 KB，存 3 份，一年大约要多少硬盘？A 2.2 TB / B 22 TB
quiz.q_en: 1 million new records a day, 2 KB each, 3 copies. About how much disk per year? A) 2.2 TB or B) 22 TB
quiz.answer_en: Answer: A, about 2.2 TB. 1M × 2 KB = 2 GB a day; × 365 ≈ 730 GB; × 3 copies ≈ 2,190 GB ≈ 2.2 TB (estimate, 1 TB = 1000 GB).
